title: Z
text: Model complex impedance, {Complex impedance (Ohm)} sets Impedance value; {Impedance type} sets the frequency dependency Frequency and {Frequency}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Impedance type
params.values: Frequency dependency Frequency independent (default) | Frequency dependent

params.name: Complex impedance (Ohm)
params.values: Impedance value 50 (default) | scalar complex number | vector of complex numbers

params.name: Frequency
params.values: Frequency values for frequency dependent impedance 1e9 (default) | nonnegative scalar number | nonnegative vector numbers
